title: Repo crossed a star milestone, never announced it
author: off-by-one
description: Compares the repository's own live stargazer count against its X account's tweet history: the count crosses a round-number milestone (10, 100, 1000, ...), but no tweet ever names it. Only the single highest milestone the live count has crossed is considered -- the biggest round number is the one worth a screenshot.
confidence_notes: No age-gate, unlike every sibling in the not-tweeted family: CountStargazers returns a live snapshot, not a timestamped crossing event, so there is no 'may simply not have tweeted yet within N hours' grace window to compute. A crossed-and-silent milestone scores a flat 0.85 -- an unambiguous, non-fuzzy signal: an exact round-number match, digit-boundary-guarded on both comma and plain spelling, gated on the word 'star' appearing in the same tweet so an unrelated number is never mistaken for an announcement. A live count that hasn't crossed the first tracked milestone yet, or a crossed milestone a tweet already names, is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden.
